item.title: Bulletin updated at 21:15 HKT 14/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a humid easterly airstream, visibility will be rather low over the coast of Guangdong at first tomorrow. The trough of low pressure now affecting the northern part of southern China is expected to develop into a cold front, and will edge southwards towards the coastal areas tomorrow. There will be showers and thunderstorms over the region. Under the persistent influence of the northeast monsoon associated with the cold front, it will become cool and windy over the coastal areas on Sunday. The weather will improve early to midweek next week. It will be dry. The weather will be cool in the morning and at night. The northeast monsoon is expected to moderate slightly in the latter part of next week. Temperatures will rise during the day over Guangdong.
